speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, two days. Item, the door is dark until Monday. Item, we rehearse the book we have and we do not open it this morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two days. Navarre's entrances, and then home. I have not brought a new page.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam, the song. On the breath. Short, and then done.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: On the breath. I had it on Wednesday.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Stop. That is a rook. You will not sing another note this morning.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: It will clear. Give me one more. I know the word.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: No. One more will teach the yard the croak. Honey later. Dumb now. Stand out of the song.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Dumb. I can be dumb. I do not like it. The word was mine on Wednesday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The word is still yours when the throat allows it. This morning it does not. Stand quiet, Sam. I am not angry with you.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A rook in the yard, and two days to go. You have a comedy that depends on a note, Will. I would laugh, except the laugh is not the part you have given me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not laugh at him. You have your own part. His throat is not a jig.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: The hooks are still split. Both of them. I turned slow all week, and the hem is where it was. I am not asking for Edith on a Saturday.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Good. I am not pinning a hem an hour before a dark dinner. One book. The slip holds. A boy's throat does not get a paste.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, no paste. Item, the boy stops. Item, we are not a surgery. Phillips has him. The rest of you have entrances.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: He stands by me. He does not sing. I will not spend a second note to prove a point to a yard with no audience.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I will stand by you. I will not try it again in the yard. I am sorry it broke.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sorry is more than the morning needs. Quiet is the whole of it. Arthur, your place is your place. Nobody is moving the songs about.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: My place is the one I had. I am not taking his word. I do not want a word that breaks.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Very noble, the both of you. The hat and I will be over here, in the part that was finished before anyone caught cold. Two days, Will. I expect a house, not a rook.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will have the house the date already names. I am not rewriting the book because a note broke.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The book we rehearsed is the book I lock. Enter where it says. The end is still enough. I will not hear a new end because a boy croaked.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Enough is the end we paid for. Item, two days. Go home when your entrance is walked. I have a house full of noise to get back to, and I will not hold it on this stage.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Come, Sam. Quiet in the tiring-house. The song is over for today.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Over for today. I heard you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Heard is enough. I am walked. The door stays dark. The book is not coming out of Abel's hand.
